subject.title: [Bug]: cloud-worker reconcile conflict is unrecoverable: stuck turn claim, blocked reclaim, restart destroys pending result

question: What is the supported conflict-resolution contract for a cloud worker whose remote result cannot be reconciled because the Gateway worktree changed after dispatch?
rationale: The current documentation promises preservation and retry, but selecting the authoritative state, operator action, and restart semantics requires ownership and data-safety judgment beyond a mechanical cache exclusion.

options.title: Specify durable recovery and implement it
options.body: Keep the worker and result recoverable, release the claim, and add one explicit retry or resolution flow that documents which workspace state wins.

options.title: Narrow the supported contract
options.body: If arbitrary divergence cannot safely be resolved, revise the product contract and surface a clear export or recovery path that never silently discards the remote result.

recommendation.title: Specify durable recovery and implement it
recommendation.body: Keep the worker and result recoverable, release the claim, and add one explicit retry or resolution flow that documents which workspace state wins.

likelyOwner.reason: The report contains the only available first-hand lifecycle evidence and identifies the intended cloud-worker recovery contract; code-history routing needs a follow-up history pass.
